# SunShade Systems Documentation Catalog

> Root documentation librarian catalog for SunShade Systems (docs.sunshade.icu).
> Designed for AI coding agents and automated context bundlers.

## Shared Architecture

- [Shared Architecture](https://docs.sunshade.icu/shared-architecture/llms-full.txt): Core platform principles, SunShade Hub SSO, and database boundary invariants.

## Registered Applications

- [Cozy](https://docs.sunshade.icu/cozy/llms-full.txt): Positivity-only behavioral home and micro-space check-in app.
- [Patchwork](https://docs.sunshade.icu/patchwork/llms-full.txt): Collaborative fabric planning and community workspace application.
- [Votary](https://docs.sunshade.icu/votary/llms-full.txt): Intentional ritual tracking and personal habit accountability system.
- [Dart-Up](https://docs.sunshade.icu/dart-up/llms-full.txt): Precision target practice and competitive tournament scoring engine.
- [SunShade Tracker](https://docs.sunshade.icu/sunshade-tracker/llms-full.txt): Central operational telemetry and audit logging dashboard.
- [SunShade Hub](https://docs.sunshade.icu/sunshade-hub/llms-full.txt): Central authentication, user accounts, and single sign-on authority.
- [SunShade DB Platform](https://docs.sunshade.icu/sunshade-db-platform/llms-full.txt): Shared PostgreSQL platform schemas, connection pooling, and multi-tenant invariants.

## Instructions for AI Agents

1. Fetch your target application context from `https://docs.sunshade.icu/{project}/llms-full.txt`.
2. Every application bundle automatically includes shared authentication and database boundaries.
3. Respect all database migration laws: client applications never execute migrations against shared schemas.
